description: This file implements the WarningReportingControl module, including classes for configuration management, a singleton proxy for warning reporting, and functions for handling warning categories, bounds, and exclusions within a warning reporting system.

classes.name: WarningReportingBoundsCategoryConfig
classes.description: JSON container class for warning reporting bounds and category configuration, including report and warning bounds and category string.

classes.name: ExcludedCategoriesValuesConfig
classes.description: JSON container class for excluded categories, including callsigns and modules arrays.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
classes.description: Singleton proxy class managing warning reporting, including category management, bounds, and exclusions.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the warning reporting proxy.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Reports a warning event for a specific module.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Fetches information about a specific warning category.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Adds a category control to the list.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Removes a category control from the list.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::Handle
methods.description: Sets the handler for warning reporting and processes queued categories.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::FillBoundsConfig
methods.description: Fills bounds configuration parameters from a JSON string.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy::FillExcludedWarnings
methods.description: Fills excluded warnings list from a JSON string.
